_tuning_notes: Global performance budget. per_player_soldier_cap: hard ceiling on loaded soldiers per online player — all spawners (hydration, reinforcement, roaming, patrols) respect it, nearest-base-to-a-player gets priority. hydration_radius: how close a player must be before a base's stored garrison count is hydrated into live entities. base_tick_seconds: cadence of the base manager cycle. roam_interval_seconds/roam_chance: how often inter-base squads are attempted.
